query: MATCH (tgt:Section) OPTIONAL MATCH (src:Section)-[:REFERENCES_SECTION]->(tgt) WITH tgt,count(DISTINCT src) AS refCount ORDER BY refCount DESC,tgt.sectionId ASC LIMIT 10 OPTIONAL MATCH (tgt)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec) OPTIONAL MATCH (cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(crSpec:Spec) WHERE crSpec.specNumber=sp.specNumber AND cr.clausesAffected IS NOT NULL AND tgt.sectionNumber IN [token IN split(cr.clausesAffected,',') | trim(token)] RETURN tgt.sectionId AS sectionId,refCount,count(DISTINCT cr) AS literalClauseCRCount ORDER BY refCount DESC,sectionId ASC
